name: ADAM-L: Andropause Explained
subtitle: Sleep, energy, strength 40+
promotionalText: Sleep, energy, strength and mood after 40 — your own numbers, explained in plain words, with one thing to try today.
description:
Your numbers from your ring and watch — and what they mean in andropause.

Sleep breaks up in the early hours. Energy is gone by mid-afternoon. Strength and drive drop, the belly grows on the same food and the same training. And in reply you hear: it's just age.

ADAM-L is made for that period — andropause in men from 40. It helps you understand what is happening with how you feel, and gives you one thing to try, in a size you can actually do.

THREE THINGS ADAM-L DOES

1. Explains the data from your device. Sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, temperature, steps — in plain words, with your age in mind, not against generic norms.
2. Helps with this specific period. Low energy, waking at night, brain fog, irritability, weight around the waist, libido, strength and recovery — each read is built around what you came with.
3. Gives you recommendations for the day and the week: sleep and evening light, meal timing, movement you can sustain, effort matched to your recovery.

THE RIGHT LOAD FOR TODAY

ADAM-L picks today's workout from your state: how you slept and recovered, what you trained yesterday and this week, your own sport on the schedule, blood pressure and when you last ate. Well recovered — strength. Less so — mobility. Pressure higher than usual — rest. A voice-guided workout counts time and cues each exercise.

FOCUS OF THE WEEK

You mark what bothers you. ADAM-L picks one main step for the week, and after seven days checks what moved, using your own 0–10 ratings: keep it, step it up, or move to the next one.

WHICH DEVICES CONNECT

• Directly: Oura and Ultrahuman rings, Polar, Withings.
• Through Apple Health: Apple Watch, plus Garmin and other watches and bands that write to Apple Health.
• No wearable: the app works fully by hand, a couple of minutes a day.

WHAT IT IS BASED ON

At its core are clinical patterns of men's health after 40: testosterone, sleep and sleep apnea, stress and cortisol, insulin response, inflammation, heart and blood vessels, muscles and bones, prostate. Behind them are 1644 scientific publications from international medical journals. Under every read there is a "What this is based on" button: title, journal, year and a link to the original.

WHAT YOU GET

• A daily read of your state in plain words, and one small thing to try.
• Your own baseline: after a couple of weeks ADAM-L compares you with you, not with a norm.
• A menu for the day, blood pressure, and a schedule for supplements and medicines with reminders.
• The ADAM-L Library: research reviews in plain words — who was studied, what was found and how much to trust it.
• Listen to your read in your phone's own voice.

A REAL SPECIALIST

When you need a person, not just an app: where available, you can order a written review of your situation or a three-month plan from a specialist. If you already work with a specialist, you can connect the app to them with their code — messages, photos and, if you choose, your data.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Your entries live on this device. There is no account and no sign-up. The text of a read is held for up to 72 hours under a random device identifier and then deleted.

IMPORTANT

ADAM-L is a wellness and lifestyle app. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, does not replace your doctor, and is not a medical device. If something in your wellbeing worries you, talk to a clinician.

SUBSCRIPTION — THREE OPTIONS

Monthly and yearly plans start with 3 days free and full access; payment is charged after 3 days unless you cancel. Or choose lifetime access with a single purchase. Subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID and renew automatically until you cancel; you can cancel any time in iPhone Settings.
